name: personal-shopper
description: A personal advisor that remembers your preferences, browses real stores as you, and helps solve problems that may or may not end in a purchase. It never buys anything — you do.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Diagnoses the problem before recommending anything — sometimes the answer is not a purchase at all
Remembers your sizes, brands, style, budget and restrictions across every session
Browses the stores you configure with your own login, so prices and availability are real
You watch the research happen in the Browser panel, and it never touches a cart or checkout
Organize what it knows about you into your own groups, without affecting how it recalls them
